profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with experience across different industries like fintech, social media, automotive and e-commerce.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Focused on driving user growth and monetization for WhatsApp. Build features across Meta apps that help bring people into WhatsApp and improve how they connect and engage, including account linking and cross-app experiences.
positions.insights: Skills: Android · iOS · PHP · Kotlin · Python (Programming Language) · Swift (Programming Language) · GraphQL

positions.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned critical authentication and user verification systems for both iOS and Android platforms, improving reliability and scalability.  
• Worked on the migration to a unified web-based authentication solution, streamlining mobile application processes.  
• Led a performance initiative to enhance user experience, reducing authentication-to-home latency from over 13 seconds to under 5 seconds.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Android · Java · Kotlin

positions.title: Staff Android Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the migration to a server-driven UI architecture for P2P payments in the Android app.  
• Elevated engineering best practices through improved code review standards and onboarding processes.  
• Enhanced the quality process across the org, significantly reducing bugs in new features.  
• Shipped multiple projects that improved payment flows, public identity, and PayPal groups.
positions.insights: Skills: Android · Kotlin · Java · Software Development

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained core messaging features for Instagram Direct, enhancing user engagement through commands, mentions, and ephemeral messaging.  
• Contributed to the migration of messaging threads to end-to-end encryption, significantly improving user privacy and system scalability.
positions.insights: Skills: Android · Kotlin · Java · Software Development
